title: pyrus torminalis var. pinnatifida
intro: Pyrus torminalis var. pinnatifida, commonly known as Chinese Wild Pear, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rosaceae. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its diverse health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Chinese Wild Pear include cardiotonic, diuretic, and sedative effects, making it useful for treating conditions such as hypertension, fever, and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Chinese Wild Pear include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to possess anti-cancer and anti-diabetic activities.
